error[ZBX-E0911]: the key's passphrase is missing, unusable or wrong
  while  getting the passphrase for the key 'ci'
  cause  the key needs a passphrase, and there is no terminal to ask on and no
         --passphrase-file
  key    ci
  fix    give the passphrase in a file only you can read:   zbx key new <name> --passphrase-file <file>
  more   zbx explain E0911
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0911.html
